title: Isomorphic Labs获5亿美元B轮融资，团队与DeepMind技术关联曝光
originalTitle: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion in its second mega-round within six months
summary: Isomorphic Labs完成5亿美元B轮融资，由Alphabet、Sequoia Capital等领投。团队核心成员来自DeepMind，其技术平台IsoDDE已超越AlphaFold 3，并推动药物进入临床试验阶段。
